name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
excluded=['MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt'];files=[]
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
for p in sorted(Path('.').rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file() or str(p) in excluded:continue
 assert not p.is_symlink();d=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':str(p),'bytes':len(d),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest()})
manifest={'algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':excluded,'exclusion_reason':'Manifest cannot hash itself; terminal runner receipt and output are generated after sealing. All other completed receipts, helpers, plans, denials, frozen-after, hashchain and handoff files included.','qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0}
s=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n'
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve()),'MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print(json.dumps({'files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'frozen_bindings':12,'mismatches':0,'qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'terminal_self_exclusions':excluded}))
